Hi all — reviewing the redlines now. A few legal notes so procurement has clarity:

1) Additional Insured: We can provide Additional Insured endorsement on the Commercial General Liability (CG 20 series or equivalent) naming the Globex corporate entity. We cannot add Globex as Additional Insured on Professional Liability/E&O — carriers generally don't provide that.

2) Endorsement Wording: We typically offer ISO CG 20 10/11 or an equivalent insurer-specific endorsement. If Globex needs broader wording (e.g., waiving subrogation or explicit primary/non-contributory), that is insurer-dependent and may take broker coordination or a premium impact.

3) Retroactive/Effective Date: We can request retroactive dating for the endorsement if the underlying policy supports it. If the policy term is already in effect, carriers sometimes allow a retro-date back to the policy inception; otherwise we can provide a COI that shows current term and request a separate endorsement. If Globex requires retro-dating to the contract effective date, please confirm so I can raise with our broker.

4) Certificate vs. Endorsement: A COI is evidence of coverage but not proof of Additional Insured status; for contractual compliance Globex should accept the insurer endorsement PDF. We can provide both.

5) Carrier contact: I will provide a carrier/broker contact for the certificate request once Mary confirms the exact entity naming and any specific additional wording.

Action items for Globex: please send the exact legal entity name (full legal name, any DBA/affiliates), and confirm whether the contract requires primary/non-contributory language or waiver of subrogation. If you can share the procurement checklist we can map items one-to-one.
